items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Walter Blue' in a list of names ('Mike Wooden-Joe, Walter Blue') and asks about who the interviewee hung around with as a kid. The interviewee responds by discussing 'Sidney Basham' and 'Michelle', but does not mention Walter Blue or confirm any personal interaction with hi

ctx.x: And James Rivers is doing some really good things again. Yes, yes. He's so authentic. Frank Butler. Well, thank you very much, Alan Toussaint. It's been a real pleasure and a real honor having you here with our WTUL audience.
